blocks.content: Currently, the layout isn't responsive and doesn't display well on mobile devices. Let's use media queries to make adjustments for screens that are 768px or narrower.

items: Stack the cards vertically on smaller screens.
Remove the tech stack and descriptions on mobile to reduce clutter.
Center-align all items within each card on mobile for a consistent look.

items: .projects-grid: On screens 768px or narrower, the grid switches to a flex layout to stack each card vertically. The gap property adds space between the stacked cards.
.tech-tag-list and .projects-card p: The tech stack and description paragraph are hidden to make the cards more compact on mobile screens.
.projects-card Alignment: On mobile, items in each project card are center-aligned for a consistent look.

blocks.content: This setup ensures the project section remains visually appealing and accessible across various screen sizes, especially on mobile.
